tasks_completed.description: AC13(a) — schema-reject path for `alternatives` on attractions/shopping/entertainment via agent-scoped BANNED_AD_HOC_KEYS extension
tasks_completed.rationale: Added module-level AGENT_SCOPED_BANNED_KEYS = {'attractions': ('alternatives',), 'shopping': ('alternatives',), 'entertainment': ('alternatives',)} (meals exempted because meals.schema.json $defs.meal_slot legitimately defines primary+alternatives[]). Added helpers _collect_agent_scoped_banned() + _scoped_in_dict() (split to satisfy MAX_NESTING=3 gate), _agent_scoped_guidance() for the verbatim guiding error message from BA spec AC13, and _reject_agent_scoped(). Extended public reject_banned(agent, agent_data) with a single trailing call to _reject_agent_scoped() — the pre-existing function body length is preserved exactly (no 'worsen' regression on the quality gate). When an attractions/shopping/entertainment payload contains 'alternatives' anywhere in its tree, reject_banned() prints 'Error: Unknown field [\'alternatives\'] for agent \'<agent>\': not yet supported on attractions/shopping/entertainment shape (only meals uses primary+alternatives[]). Full unification is M2 spec scope; for this cycle, use the flat list + optional:true shape.' and sys.exit(1). Meals payload bypasses the scoped check entirely (scoped_keys lookup returns None for 'meals').

tasks_completed.description: AC13(b) — shape-normalizer _normalize_to_canonical_record(item, shape) + inverse _denormalize() with lossless round-trip
tasks_completed.rationale: Added module constants SHAPE_MEALS_NESTED='meals_nested' and SHAPE_FLAT_OPTIONAL='flat_optional'. Forward path: _normalize_meals_slot() splits a meals slot {primary, alternatives[]} into an ordered list of canonical records — primary first then alternatives in source-order, each carrying _canonical_role ('primary'|'alternative'|'flat'), _canonical_slot (meal_type or None), and _canonical_alt_index (int or None). _normalize_flat_item() maps a flat-shape item dict to a single canonical record. Inverse path: _denormalize_meals() rebuilds the slot by (a) emitting a 'primary' key only when a primary record is present and (b) emitting an 'alternatives' key only when at least one alternative record exists — preserving the source absence of 'alternatives' when meals slots have only primary (per meals.schema.json which marks 'alternatives' as optional). _strip_canonical_fields() removes the three bookkeeping fields. _denormalize() inverse for flat shape is the strip alone. Unknown shape raises ValueError naming the two valid constants. The canonical record format means W5's check_cross_domain_dedup() (scripts/lib/semantic_lint.py) can be retrofitted to call _normalize_to_canonical_record() once and compare shape-agnostically; W5's handoff notes confirm this upgrade is deferred to a follow-up.

tasks_completed.description: AC13(a) schema documentation — $comment block on attractions/shopping/entertainment schemas citing M2 unification plan
tasks_completed.rationale: Added a top-level $comment field (standard JSON-Schema 2020-12 annotation — no semantic effect on validation) on each of attractions/shopping/entertainment.schema.json pointing at (a) the schema's existing additionalProperties:false as the structural rejection mechanism for alternatives at item level, (b) the M2 unification deferral in docs/feature-status.md, and (c) the binding enforcement point in scripts/lib/save_translate.py AGENT_SCOPED_BANNED_KEYS / _reject_agent_scoped(). Verified each schema still parses as JSON and passes Draft202012Validator.check_schema(). The binding rejection lives in save_translate.py per the BA spec; the schema $comment is documentation only.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — pre-existing systematic state (Bug 10 schema asymmetry: meals.schema.json uses primary+alternatives[] but attractions/shopping/entertainment use a flat list with optional:true)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The four POI-shape schemas were authored at different times for different sub-problems; meals legitimately needed primary+alternatives[] for restaurant fallback, while the others were modeled as a flat list. No save-layer guard ever enforced 'agents writing attractions/shopping/entertainment must not include alternatives[]', so a careless agent payload could silently smuggle the field — schema rejection at validate-time would catch it, but only after the file write. The renderer would then have no support and the data would be silently dropped.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Two complementary changes: (1) the writing path now rejects 'alternatives' on the three flat-shape agents with a guiding error message pointing at the M2 unification scope and the current correct shape (flat list + optional:true); (2) the shape-normalizer provides a single canonical record format so cross-shape callers (W5's cross-domain dedup) can compare items shape-agnostically without each caller re-implementing the shape switch. Codex round-2 Q2 explicitly ruled out the accept-but-ignore middle option as a silent-data-loss trap; this implementation enforces the hard reject.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: save_translate.py grew from 84 → 277 lines (193 net). 120 lines is the minimum for the documented function surface (constants + 3 reject helpers + 3 normalize helpers + 3 denormalize helpers + docstrings); the additional 73 lines are gate-driven splits: _scoped_in_dict was extracted from _collect_agent_scoped_banned to satisfy MAX_NESTING=3; _normalize_meals_alts was extracted from _normalize_meals_slot to keep the latter under MAX_FUNC_LINES=30; _collect_meals_records was extracted from _denormalize_meals for the same reason. The pre-existing reject_banned() body is preserved byte-for-byte (no quality-gate 'no worsen' regression); only a single trailing call to _reject_agent_scoped() is appended. Schema $comment edits are 1 line each * 3 files = 3 lines.
